title: 飛機鋁合金蒙皮成形
summary: 以鋁合金蒙皮試片與原創成形示意，連接曲率、應變、回彈、公差及孔緣品質；不提供機台壓力或航空加工SOP。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use aluminium-skin coupons and original forming sketches to connect curvature, strain, springback, tolerances and hole-edge quality, without machine pressure or production SOPs. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 曲率與外纖維應變：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Curvature and outer-fibre strain: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 曲率與外纖維應變 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Curvature and outer-fibre strain and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 外表面彎曲應變約為厚度除兩倍中性層半徑；卸載彈性回復造成回彈，不能只看模具角度。
steps.instructionEn: Outer-fibre bending strain is approximately thickness divided by twice the neutral-layer radius; elastic recovery causes springback, so die angle alone is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非飛機鋁合金蒙皮成形實際性能或製程：板厚t=1 mm，中性層半徑R=20 mm。式 ε≈t/(2R)，基準結果 2.5 %。適用條件：小厚徑比幾何近似，未含中性層移動、塑性各向異性或成形極限。 無因次分率乘100轉百分率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aircraft aluminum-skin forming: Sheet thickness t=1 mm and neutral-layer radius R=20 mm. Formula ε≈t/(2R) gives 2.5 %. Conditions: Small thickness/radius geometric approximation, excluding neutral-axis shift, plastic anisotropy and forming limits. Multiply a dimensionless fraction by 100 for percent.
steps.failure: 只改模具角度卻忽略材料批次和軋向會使回彈不可重現。
steps.failureEn: Changing die angle while ignoring material batch and rolling direction makes springback irreproducible.
steps.check: 對比卸載前後輪廓及板厚分布，標軋延方向並量測表面應變。
steps.checkEn: Compare loaded/unloaded profiles and thickness distributions, mark rolling direction and measure surface strain.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把R改成25 mm；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 2.5 改為 2 %。在算式區重算並記下對「曲率與外纖維應變」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only R to 25 mm, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 2.5 to 2 %. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Curvature and outer-fibre strain, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 成形後淨截面：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Net section after forming: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 成形後淨截面 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Net section after forming and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 平均應力是載荷除承載淨截面；孔洞會同時減少面積並帶來局部應力集中。
steps.instructionEn: Average stress is load divided by net load-bearing area; holes both remove area and cause local concentration.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非飛機鋁合金蒙皮成形實際性能或製程：F=10000 N，A=200 mm²。式 σ=F/A，基準結果 50 MPa。適用條件：均勻軸拉平均應力，1 N/mm²=1 MPa；不能判定局部破壞。 應力若以Pa算出，除10⁶轉MPa；N/mm²已等於MPa。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aircraft aluminum-skin forming: F=10000 N and A=200 mm². Formula σ=F/A gives 50 MPa. Conditions: Uniform axial average stress, with 1 N/mm²=1 MPa; it does not determine local failure. Divide pascals by 10^6 for MPa; N/mm² already equals MPa.
steps.failure: 用毛截面積低估孔排附近的平均應力，不能靠增加樣本數消除此偏差。
steps.failureEn: Gross area underestimates average stress near hole rows; extra samples do not remove this bias.
steps.check: 從圖面扣除孔洞面積，再比較應變規位置與淨截面；保留材料方向。
steps.checkEn: Subtract hole area from the drawing, compare gauge position with net section, and retain material orientation.
